fact.subject: max-backoff
fact.note: URL parameter max-backoff (form tag at line 22); default applied at line 72-73 when the parsed value is 0. It caps the retry sleep after a failed Consul service fetch (consul.go Max: tgt.MaxBackoff), not a heartbeat or session timeout. The files state no default for the wait, timeout or healthy parameters.
